findings.summary: parseSimTarget accepts a literal $param in block position as a block id (non-canonical, never produced by formatSimTarget)
label/port readers duplicated from simExternalElements.ts; consolidate when a later WP touches both
a V-Lab port with neither domain nor direction is listed as conserving with no across/through
coffee global X-Bridges model (AC_MOTOR_PID_CONTROL) diverges to ~1e58 headless with RK4 at dt 0.01 from t=0.2; not used as a fixture; inferred from a probe, not root-caused
reportSnapshotAdapter builds its snapshot without external elements, so report diagnostics may still list UNRESOLVED_ENDPOINT for state and sim links (pre-existing for states); pick up in WP-10
Simulate button only in the standard RTM table, not the virtualized grid; X-Bridges/V-Lab runs cover the global canvas only (workspace-file canvases not yet)

V-Lab integrates with BDF1 at start/after input events then variable-step BDF2 with error control: a plain-arithmetic reference cannot be bit-exact. Phase-2 tests verify ordering bit-exactly against a manual session loop and physics against the exact first-order-lag solution with a tolerance.
